P.name: Harrier
P.title: Template:Data Quinn/Harrier
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Harrier|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Quinn
|skill        = I
|icon         = Harrier.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Quinn}} damaging abilities mark enemies with ''Harrier'' and {{tip|standard sight|reveal}} them for a few seconds. Periodically, {{ui|Valor}} marks a nearby enemy with ''Harrier''.
|blurb2      = '''Quinn's''' next basic attack against a ''Harrier'' target consumes the mark to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Quinn's''' ''{{ai|Blinding Assault|Quinn}}'' against the primary target, ''{{ai|Vault|Quinn}}'', and ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}'' mark enemies hit with ''Harrier'' for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}. '''{{ci|Valor}}''' will periodically mark a nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy if no ''Harrier'' targets exist for 1 second.
|description2 = '''Quinn's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against ''Harrier'' targets are empowered to consume the mark to deal {{pp|15 + (120-15)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=physical damage}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
|description3 = ''Harrier'' deals {{as|75 '''bonus''' physical damage}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
|description4 = While ''{{ai|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}}'' is active, ''Harrier'' is disabled and all ''Harrier'' marks are removed.
|effect radius= 525
|static       = {{tt|{{pp|type=critical strike chance|color=critical chance|7*(0.99^((x-1)*10))|key1=%|0 to 100 by 10|formula=7*(0.99^critical strike chance %)}}|Starts after the mark expired or was consumed or overwritten by another mark.}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = Physical
|parry        = True
|spelleffects = Proc
|spellshield  = False
|notes   = 
* If a mark applied by an ability is overwritten, consumed, or timed out, ''Harrier'' goes on a 1-second cooldown if it's not already on cooldown.
* ''Harrier's'' targeting priority:
*# Last unit hit (if it was a small minion it appears to select a different target).
*# Lowest-health enemy champion.
*# Lowest-health enemy minion.
* ''Harrier'' is consumed even if it is parried, the attack is negated in any case.
* ''Harrier'' will not mark enemy {{tip|minions}} while '''Quinn''' is not {{tip|sight|visible}}, but will mark enemy {{tip|champions}}.
}}

E.name: Vault
E.title: Template:Data Quinn/Vault
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Vault|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Quinn
|skill        = E
|icon         = Vault.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Quinn}} {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}}, marking them with {{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}, and briefly {{tip|slow|slowing}} them. She then {{tip|dash|leaps}} backward.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy, marking them with ''{{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}'', dealing {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} a very short distance over {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 50% decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. She then {{tip|dash|leaps back}} 525 units away from them.
|description2 = ''Vault {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Quinn's''' basic attack timer {{tt|shortly after|See notes}} the initial dash. {{ai|Heightened Senses|Quinn}} can be cast during either of the dashes.''
|leveling     = {{st|Physical damage|{{ap|40 to 140}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|12 to 8}}
|cast time = none
|cost         = 50
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 600
|speed        = {{dv|{{tt|2500|Initial dash speed, estimated}}|{{tt|850|Return dash speed, estimated}}}}
|targeting    = Unit
|damagetype   = Physical
|affects      = Enemies
|spelleffects = Spell
|spellshield  = True
|callforhelp  = true
|grounded     = True
|knockdown    = True
|notes   = 
* '''Quinn''' will track the target if they change locations.
** She will dash to the target's previous location without applying ''Vault's'' effects if the target is too far away or moves beyond {{tt|1200|Estimated}} units.
* ''Vault'' {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Quinn's''' remaining attack cooldown a short delay after the first dash ends (even if interrupted).
** This delay is a fuzzy {{fd|0.25}} to {{fd|0.5}} seconds and this matches up with the moment the target of ''Vault'' is marked with {{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}.
* '''Quinn''' will automatically attempt to attack the target once she completes ''Vault''.
* The target will turn to face the opposite direction after being {{tip|airborne|knocked back}}.
* Unlike its constant cast range ''Vault's'' bounce's can vary to allow '''Quinn''' to close or to make a gap between herself and the target (depending on casting position) or even to jump through a wall (if there is enough landing room on the other side).
* ''Vault's'' {{tip|airborne|knock back}} also interrupts the windup of basic attacks with {{tip|uncancellable windup|uncancellable windups}}.{{bug|2}}
}}

R.name: Behind Enemy Lines
R.title: Template:Data Quinn/Behind Enemy Lines
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Behind Enemy Lines|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Quinn
|skill        = R
|icon         = Behind Enemy Lines.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Quinn}} {{tip|channels}} for a short time to pair up with {{ci|Valor}}. They then become united, increasing her {{as|{{sti|movement speed}}}} and becoming {{tip|ghosted}}.
|blurb2      = The duo lose the movement speed boost upon taking non-minion damage, and disband upon being {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}}.
|blurb3      = While united, '''Quinn''' can cast ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}''.
|post-blurb= Quinn/Skystrike
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' {{tip|channels}} for 2 seconds, signaling '''{{ci|Valor}}''' to pair up. Upon completion, he picks her up and they unite, increasing her {{sti|ms|{{as|{{tt|'''total''' movement speed|Increases base movement as well as bonus movement speed}}}}}}, granting her {{tip|ghosted|ghosting}}, and allowing her to cast ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}''. ''Behind Enemy Lines'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel.
|leveling     = {{st|Total Movement Speed Increase|{{ap|70 to 130}}%}}
|description2 = Taking damage from non-{{tip|minions}} while ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is active or while '''Quinn''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}} the ability causes her to lose the {{as|'''bonus total''' movement speed}} for 3 seconds. Becoming {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}} ends ''Behind Enemy Lines'' immediately and puts it on {{sti|cooldown}} without performing ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}''.
|description3 = Once ''Behind Enemy Lines'' has been learned, [[death|respawning]] or entering {{tt|any|see notes}} [[Spawn|summoning platform]] will spawn '''{{ci|Valor}}''' instantly.
|description4 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Quinn''' cancels the channel, placing ''Behind Enemy Lines'' on cooldown.
|cooldown     = 3
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = {{ap|50 to 0}}
|cast time = {{fd|0.25}}
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Self
|grounded     = true
|silence      = true
|notes        = 
* Taking damage from non-{{tip|minions}} removes the bonus movement speed buff temporarily by suppressing it with the status effect of a {{tip|slow}}.
** This slow is not affected by {{tip|slow resist}} or {{tip|slow immunity}}, but it can be {{tip|cleanse|cleansed}}.
** While the slow is in effect, ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is not considered to grant increased {{as|movement speed}} for the purpose of {{ri|Celerity}}.
* ''Behind Enemy Lines'' does not refund its {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} if the channel was canceled via recast.
** The only exception is if '''Quinn's''' {{as|mana}} falls below the {{as|mana cost}}, in which case she is granted enough {{as|mana}} back (the equal amount needed) to be able to cast ''Behind Enemy Lines'' again.
* [[death|Respawning]] or returning to the [[Spawn|summoning platform]] will not spawn '''{{ci|Valor}}''' if ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is on cooldown.
* If '''{{ci|Valor}}''' is spawned by [[death|respawning]] or returning to the [[Spawn|summoning platform]], {{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}} will be disabled from being manually cast for {{fd|2.5}} seconds upon uniting. However, it will still automatically activate upon declaring a {{tip|basic attack}} or casting {{ai|Blinding Assault|Quinn}} or {{ai|Vault|Quinn}}.
* ''Behind Enemy Lines'' ends immediately without {{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}} being cast if she enters or is inside the enemy [[fountain]]. The ability will go on full {{sti|cooldown}}.
** '''Quinn''' will also spawn '''{{ci|Valor}}''' when entering the enemy fountain.{{bug}}
* Self or allied applied {{tip|immobilize|immobilizations}} such as {{ui|Blast Cone}}, {{ai|Tempered Fate|Bard}}, and {{ii|Zhonya's Hourglass}} also count for ending ''Behind Enemy Lines''.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Quinn''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
** ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is not a [[Channel#Movement Channels|movement channel]], and so will not be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|root}} and {{tip|ground}}.
{{ct|channel|attack=interrupts|cast=interrupts|move=false|items=interrupts,true,,false|spells=true, interrupts, interrupts, interrupts, interrupts}}
|flavorsound   = {{sm2|Quinn_Original_R_1.ogg}} ''"Valor, to me!"''
}}

R.name: Skystrike
R.title: Template:Data Quinn/Skystrike
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Skystrike|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Quinn
|skill        = R
|pre-blurb = Quinn/Behind Enemy Lines
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Quinn}} disbands from {{ci|Valor}} and rains arrows down around her, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.
|blurb2      = '''Quinn's''' {{tip|basic attack|attacks}} and damaging abilities automatically activate ''Skystrike''.
|icon         = Skystrike.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' detaches from '''Valor''', ending ''{{ais|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}}'' effects and raining arrows down around her, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and marking them with ''{{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}''.
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|60 to 120}} {{as|(+ 35% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description2 = Declaring a {{tip|basic attack}} or casting ''{{ai|Blinding Assault|Quinn}}'' or ''{{ai|Vault|Quinn}}'' during ''{{ai|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}}'' automatically activates ''Skystrike''.
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 700
|cast time    = none
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|notes        = 
* If '''Quinn''' uses {{ai|Vault|Quinn}} while {{ai|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}} is active, ''Skystrike'' will activate at her target's location after she bounces back.
* Upon respawning or recalling, '''Quinn's''' first ''Skytrike'' will deal double the normal amount of damage to enemies hit if activated by an ability.{{bug|1}}
}}
